Katol.advisory: High humidity may trigger citrus greening or fruit drop in Orange orchards. Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture. Clear stagnant water from plant roots.

Saoner.advisory: Soybean pod-filling stage is active. Monitor for semi-looper infestations. Apply Neem-based pesticide if leaf damage exceeds 10% threshold.

Bhiwapur.advisory: Chilli crops are in flowering stage. Ensure light micro-irrigation at regular intervals. Avoid water logging to prevent damping-off disease.

Kuhi.advisory: Paddy transplanting completed. Maintain water level at 5cm depth in fields. Add Nitrogen fertilizers during dry intervals.

Kalmeshwar.advisory: Orange fruit harvesting season approaches. Apply copper oxychloride paste to tree trunks to protect from fungal root rots.

Hingna.advisory: Cotton vegetative growth stage. Check for Pink Bollworm moths in pheromone traps. Install yellow sticky traps for sucking pests.

Ramtek.advisory: Ensure proper field drainage for Tur (Pigeon pea) and Paddy fields to prevent phytophthora blight and root damage.

Kamptee.advisory: Veterinary Advisory: Keep cattle inside during rain. Ensure regular vaccination against Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD).

Umred.advisory: Cotton field weeding is advised. Apply organic mulch to conserve soil moisture. Check for early signs of jassids and aphids.

Narkhed.advisory: Mosambi/Orange growers should start pruning dead twigs. Apply well-decomposed Farm Yard Manure (FYM) with Trichoderma.

Savner.advisory: Soybean crop requires nitrogen top-dressing. Take advantage of light rainfall to apply urea or DAP between crop rows.

Mouda.advisory: Paddy tillering stage. Spray zinc sulphate if leaves show light brown rusty spots indicating zinc deficiency.

Parseoni.advisory: Drain water from maize crops. Fungal leaf blight may appear in wet conditions. Apply recommended organic fungicides if severe.
